stories.headline: Marathon reveals Symbiosis PvE mode and December 8 free-play week
stories.summary: Bungie's Symbiosis update arrives December 8 with Expedition, a permanent PvE-only mode built around three escalating runs. It also introduces the Limbo social hub, a 3v3 Deathmatch beta, the blade-wielding Bishop shell and a transformed Perimeter map. Everyone can play free from December 8 to 15, with earned progress retained if they later buy the game.

stories.headline: Helldivers 2 plans hotfix to restore some cosmetic mods after anti-cheat backlash
stories.summary: Arrowhead says its switch to Easy Anti-Cheat disrupted cosmetic modifications and that adjustments in the next hotfix should allow some non-gameplay mods to work again. Gameplay-altering mods remain unsupported and may be treated as cheats. The studio also acknowledged delayed quality-of-life fixes and outlined improvements for early December, without confirming a hotfix date.

stories.headline: HARMA targets November 16 Early Access launch with dark-fantasy deckbuilding
stories.summary: IndirectShine's pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder is listed for November 16 Early Access on Steam. Players manipulate three artifact activations to influence card effects, with a story campaign across four acts, two playable characters and more than 300 cards and artifacts. A demo is already available, and the game has Steam Deck Verified status.

stories.headline: Trafficity launches November 16 with detailed road and traffic simulation
stories.summary: Onramp Games' PC and Mac city builder is scheduled for November 16. Its focus is road engineering, from roundabouts and custom traffic lights to lane connections and complex interchanges, all tested by an agent-based traffic model. It also offers procedural maps, four biomes, three difficulty levels and a relaxed Chill Mode.

stories.headline: Here Comes the Horde arrives November 16 with massive castle-defense battles
stories.summary: Polished Games' incremental auto-battler is scheduled for November 16. Defend a castle against undead waves by recruiting peasants, knights, archers and mages, with battles designed to scale to tens of thousands of units. The game advertises 30 levels, hundreds of upgrades, voiced character banter and a playable demo.

stories.headline: Fanatical's Birthday Bash PC game sale ends November 16
stories.summary: The PC key retailer's Birthday Bash promotion concludes on November 16 after discounts spanning Sega, Capcom, Bethesda, Bandai Namco and other publishers. The event has also featured rotating 24-hour flash deals. Previously reported prices and percentages may have changed, so check the retailer's live offers before purchasing.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever narrows dungeon XP penalty to 12-level gap
stories.summary: Blizzard has revised its dungeon anti-boosting hotfix after the first version blocked experience for ordinary groups in dungeons with wide enemy level ranges. XP is now nullified only when a higher-level party member is more than 12 levels above the enemies. The revised restriction is live but does not apply to dungeon instances already underway when the change was deployed.

stories.headline: Overwatch director explains why Hudson changed from Support to Damage
stories.summary: Game director Aaron Keller says the upcoming omnic detective Hudson began development as a Support hero, but the team struggled to make that version work. Testing Hudson as a Damage hero produced a much stronger result, Keller says, explaining the decision amid player disappointment over Season 6 adding another DPS instead of a new Support.

stories.headline: Spirit Crossing launches on PC November 16 with introductory discount
stories.summary: Spry Fox's cozy multiplayer adventure is now released on Steam. Explore a cloud-top world, help lost spirits, build and decorate a home, and meet other players at your own pace. The developers say progress from the earlier Steam demo carries over to the full game. An introductory 10% discount is listed through November 23.

stories.headline: Steam Auto-Battler RPG Fest opens November 16 at 19:00
stories.summary: Valve's themed Steam event runs from November 16 at 19:00 to November 23 at 19:00, featuring games where combat plays out automatically but strategy comes from building and upgrading units. Steamworks says the festival will highlight discounted games, upcoming releases and playable demos. Exact participating discounts were not confirmed before opening.

stories.headline: SteamOS 3.10 Preview improves Nvidia GPU support and AMD HDMI 2.1 VRR
stories.summary: Valve's November 13 SteamOS 3.10.0 Preview improves Nvidia graphics stability and performance, adds Mesh Shader support for Turing and newer GPUs, and fixes rendering corruption in Shadow of the Tomb Raider and The Surge 2. AMD GPUs gain HDMI 2.1 VRR, FRL and ALLM support. This is a Preview-channel build based on Linux kernel 7.3, not a stable release.

stories.headline: Foxhole unveils Engines of War update for December 7
stories.summary: Siege Camp's 68th Foxhole update arrives December 7, expanding its persistent battlefield with light submarines, sonar patrol boats, torpedo bombers, mobile radar jammers and anti-air battle tanks. Logistics and engineering players gain concrete trucks, new defensive bunkers, ship throttle controls and interface improvements. The update is scheduled, not live yet.

stories.headline: Rainbow Six Siege reveals Operation Vital Signal with Doc overhaul and Ranked split
stories.summary: Ubisoft's Year 11 Season 4, Operation Vital Signal, is due in December. Doc's new E-HEAL Monitor can remotely heal or revive teammates, Ranked separates Solo/Duo and Flex queues, and Bank receives a targeted map update. The season also adds the MBZ-19 defender weapon, a new social hub and balancing changes. An exact season launch date has not been announced.

stories.headline: Xbox Project Helix is designed as a console that also plays PC games
stories.summary: Xbox's next-generation VP Jason Ronald says Project Helix is being built as a console first, with access to PC games and four generations of Xbox titles. He emphasized a simple, instant-play experience alongside deeper performance settings for power users. Microsoft is pursuing neural rendering to improve performance without proportional hardware cost increases. No launch date has been announced.
